install.notes: pyproject.toml:40-49 requires Python >=3.7,<3.11, gymnasium and numpy<2.0.0; setup.py:61-65 compiles the CMake extension evogym.simulator_cpp. The gate and the fake backend import neither: fake.py is pure Python. The upstream install is only needed to serve the real simulator, which requires a robot body argument and was not run and is not declared as a backend.
